title: Not by Might
question: If the work is not done by strength, how does Scripture say it gets done?
blurb: Said over a half-built temple. Four verses about small means and large outcomes.

nodes.content: If the work is not done by strength, how does Scripture say it gets done?

nodes.verseText: So he said to me, “This is the word of the LORD to Zerubbabel: Not by might nor by power, but by My Spirit, says the LORD of Hosts.
And all those assembled here will know that it is not by sword or spear that the LORD saves; for the battle is the LORD’s, and He will give all of you into our hands.”
Then the LORD said to Gideon, “You have too many men for Me to deliver Midian into their hands, lest Israel glorify themselves over Me, saying, ‘My own hand has saved me.’
Some trust in chariots and others in horses, but we trust in the name of the LORD our God.
But He said to me, “My grace is sufficient for you, for My power is perfected in weakness.” Therefore I will boast all the more gladly in my weaknesses, so that the power of Christ may rest on me.
